baseline.formula: previous_return = prior close / prior-prior close - 1; momentum = mean(last 3 daily returns); volatility = population standard deviation(last 4 daily returns); expected_return = clamp(round(0.60 × momentum - 0.10 × volatility, 2), -5, +5); expected_open = round(prior_close × (1 + expected_return / 100), 2); actual_return = actual_open / prior_close - 1; error = actual_return - expected_return.
baseline.note: This is a reproducible public-daily baseline generated after the fact because no historical 08:20 pre-open quote/order-book snapshot is available. It uses only the five prior trading-session daily closes, is not the historical 08:20 forecast, and must not be described as one.
